theme_strategy: Vivid modern AI agent dashboard with friendly student-crafted aesthetic, smooth execution timeline, high-contrast parameter chips, and interactive mock booking cards.

responsive.layout: Stack single column on mobile (<768px). On desktop (>=768px), split into side-by-side or multi-column grid: left column for Chat Input & Execution Timeline, right column for Extracted Parameters, Options Selection, and Active Ticket/Booking confirmation.
responsive.typography: Mobile-first scaling using responsive Tailwind classes (e.g. text-xl sm:text-2xl md:text-3xl). Inputs must have min height 44px to avoid auto-zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure max-w-full and overflow-x-hidden on root containers to eliminate horizontal scrollbars on smaller viewports.
responsive.tap_targets: All buttons, tab chips, slot buttons, and interactive cards must have min 44px height/width for easy tapping.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200/60 dark:border-slate-800/60 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/5
visual_enhancers.ticket_notch: relative rounded-xl border border-dashed border-indigo-300 dark:border-indigo-800 p-4 bg-indigo-50/50 dark:bg-slate-800/50

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files in src/ (do NOT use .tsx files).

Include data-testid attributes on all key interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='goal-input', data-testid='submit-goal-btn', data-testid='prompt-preset-movie', data-testid='confirm-booking-btn', data-testid='past-bookings-tab').

Show a full agent workflow execution timeline with 7 distinct steps: 1. Request understood -> 2. Parameters extracted -> 3. Searching inventory -> 4. Options presented -> 5. User choice registered -> 6. Price calculated & verified -> 7. Mock booking confirmed.
Provide realistic mock data for Indian cities including Bhilai, Raipur, Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Pune with INR prices (₹).

Support 3 distinct booking types: Movies (Mirzapur, Stree 2, Pushpa 2, Kalki), Hotels (Sayaji Raipur, Hotel Grand Bhilai, Taj Palace Delhi, JW Marriott Mumbai), and Flights (IndiGo 6E-402, Air India AI-801, Vistara UK-923).

Provide 3 quick prompt preset chips for fast testing during viva demo ('Book 2 movie tickets for Mirzapur tomorrow evening in Bhilai', 'Book a luxury hotel in Raipur for 2 nights starting Friday', 'Find flights from Raipur to Delhi for next Monday morning').
Display extracted parameter cards prominently showing intent type badge, location, date, ticket/guest count, class/seat preference, and price estimation.
Include interactive options selection with real-time total price calculation before final confirmation step.
Include a simulated booking confirmation ticket complete with unique booking ID (e.g. AURA-MOV-8921), QR code placeholder, mock breakdown, and 'SIMULATED BOOKING CONFIRMED' badge.
Persist past simulated bookings in localStorage so users can view booking history and clear history if needed.
Add a smooth step-by-step auto simulation trigger button ('Run Full Agent Auto-Demo') for effortless live viva presentation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Maintain high contrast and accessibility for light and dark themes.
Do not add universal transition: all CSS rules. Specify transition on individual elements.
Never center align the root app container. Use natural left-aligned reading flows.
Use Lucide icons and colorful badges for visual clarity.
Ensure sonner is used for dynamic alerts and toasts.
